description:
Manage History Import

Import past conversations, optionally discovering relevant CRM relationships.

The web equivalent is People → Import → Past conversations. Workspace
owners/operators only; pilot gates remain effective. Vruum also offers a
default import in Actions when an owner connects an account.
First fetch history_import_setup. Fetch history_import_preview with
contact_selection=recent (people who replied first, then the most recently
active, up to 1,000 identities; contacts_limited=true when more exist) or with selected person_ids
from history_import_people, plus source/date limits. Optional
discover_relationships=true permits empty person_ids. Explain bounded private
samples, model screening and quote verification, the $2 model allowance,
research-candidate additions, evidence retention, and conditional undo.
- propose: no id. Payload {scope, scope_digest, client_request_id}; copy the
  preview's scope unchanged. Retain the UUID request ID on exact retries.
  This saves one review Action and reads no provider data.
- approve: id=run UUID. Show the saved scope and disclosures to the human
  before calling. Payload {scope_digest, expected_action_version} from a
  fresh fetch history_import. Approval authorizes metadata enumeration and
  matched bodies within saved limits. A discovery scope also authorizes its
  sampled model review and verified contact/account additions. Existing-only
  scopes run no models. Neither scope authorizes sending or qualification.
- pause/resume: id=run UUID, no payload. Preserve the exact approved scope.
  Reconnect the source in Integrations before retrying a disconnected run.
  Changed accounts/identities require a new preview and approval.
- stop: id=run UUID, no payload. End further work and retain captured history.
- remove: id=run UUID, no payload. Confirm removal with the human. Deletes
  this import's history and discovery evidence; untouched new memberships are
  archived. Changed records and memberships used elsewhere survive.

Poll fetch history_import; page history_import_batches for receipts.
Source completeness stays unverified, including after complete_with_gaps.
Read captured bodies through fetch relationship_history / relationship_history_detail,
subtype=people, id=person UUID. Never fabricate native message IDs.

### Responses:

**200**: Successful Response (Success Response)
Content-Type: application/json

action.description: The operation to perform — see the tool description for the action vocabulary and each action's id/payload semantics.
action.title: action

for_company.description: Optional company ID or name (UUID, or case-insensitive EXACT name match — partial / substring matches are NOT supported; ambiguous names raise 400) to execute this tool as. Use get_operator_companies, or get_operator_overview with view='companies', to list available companies. Only needed if you manage multiple companies. Access is enforced server-side: the tool resolves the value to a user_company_id and verifies the caller's membership in `company_users` — a 403 'Company not found or access denied' means EITHER the value did not match a known company OR the caller is not a member of it. The MCP operator role itself is NOT auto-granted — operators get this access by being members of each client company via `company_users` (the same row that grants any normal user access).
for_company.title: for_company

id.description: Target entity id, or an ARRAY of ids to apply the same action+payload to each (max 100; see the tool description for which entity the id names per action).
id.title: id

items.description: For create-like actions only: an array of per-item payloads processed in order with per-item results (max 100). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `payload`.
items.title: items

payload.description: Action-specific fields, validated by the underlying route's own schema (a bad field 422s with that route's precise errors). See the tool description per action.
payload.title: payload
